value.rationale: Numerical spectral LMPs built with approximate Ritz vectors require a scale chosen before the direction error is known. The exact robust scale, unique optimum and exact worst-angle law provide a parameter-selection criterion, a sharp failure boundary for the common theta=1 choice, and an asymptotic distinction between avoiding harm and achieving uniformly bounded conditioning. This is a natural complete robustness classification for a two-mode SPD preconditioning model, not a mere re-labeling of a linear algebra identity. It does not promise multidimensional or end-to-end solver acceleration.
